description: pitwall (T3a): a session brief, guards on secrets, main, merge protection, ai-review and their own switch, call budgets, and the gate after edits and before stopping; in pitwall projects only

hooks.command: if [ ! -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pitwall.json" ]; then :; elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.mjs" session-start; else printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"pitwall: Node.js is not on PATH, so its guards refuse every tool call. Install the Node LTS from https://nodejs.org, or turn pitwall off in this project: claude plugin disable pitwall@pitwall --scope local"}'; fi
